name: taboola-mcp
description: Taboola Realize (Taboola Ads) (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report, update_budget. E

platform_mcp_taboola_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TABOOLA_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_taboola_client_id.description: Backstage API client_id provided by your Taboola account manager.

platform_mcp_taboola_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TABOOLA_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_taboola_client_secret.description: The matching client_secret; client-credentials tokens last 12 hours (no refresh token) and are re-requested automatically.

platform_mcp_taboola_account_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TABOOLA_ACCOUNT_ID
platform_mcp_taboola_account_id.description: Taboola account_id (the string id, e.g. demo-advertiser, from list_accounts) used by update_budget and pause_resume, whose paths are /backstage/api/1.0/{account_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id}.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /backstage/api/1.0/users/current/account: the credentials' own account (id, name, account_id, currency, time_zone_name).

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: GET /backstage/api/1.0/users/current/allowed-accounts: every account the credentials may use. `id` is the string account_id used in paths (raw.id is the numeric id).

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /backstage/api/1.0/{account_id}/campaigns/?fetch_level=RAP (recent campaigns, paused included; deleted ones are never returned). `budget` is daily_cap in the account currency (0 = unlimited; applies with daily_ad_delivery_model STRICT); raw.is_active is the on/off switch and raw.spending_limit the total cap. `status` is not a filter.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: GET /backstage/api/1.0/{account_id}/reports/campaign-summary/dimensions/campaign_day_breakdown?start_date&end_date: one row per campaign per day in the account time zone. campaign_id is not applied (this dimension has no campaign filter). Clicks can still change for 48 hours and conversions for 30 days.

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: POST /backstage/api/1.0/{account_id config}/campaigns/{campaign_id} {daily_cap}: the daily budget in the account currency (`currency` is ignored); spends money. It applies when daily_ad_delivery_model is STRICT and must stay below spending_limit; 0 means unlimited.
